name: Logger offline
note: Also the sign of a power cut at the panel (no UPS for the trial)

name: Power interruption detected
condition: logger restarted after a power loss (boot=poweron after a gap)
note: Sent on return; gives the outage start and end from the gap

name: Phase lost
note: One phase down while the meter still runs on another

name: Undervoltage
note: 230 V nominal -10%; confirm against the PLN supply

name: Overvoltage
note: 230 V nominal +5%; confirm against the PLN supply

name: Frequency out of range
note: Usually means the genset is supplying

name: High demand
condition: apparent power above % of contracted kVA
note: Contracted kVA to set in site.json

name: Current imbalance
condition: max phase current deviation from the mean above
note: Ignored when the mean current is below 5 A

name: Temp/RH sensor fault
condition: no valid reading (timeout or checksum) for

name: SD card error
note: Data is still sent while online but not kept locally

name: Clock not set
condition: RTC time invalid or more than 2 min off NTP

name: Energy counter went backwards
condition: cumulative kWh lower than the previous reading

name: Push to OED failing
condition: no successful push to OED for
note: Data is safe in the site folder; OED is behind

name: Sensors disagree
condition: difference between TH1 and TH2 temperature above
note: Enable only when both sensors are in the same room; a sign that one sensor drifts
